Message.Name: Channel Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Sent on a market data channel every 3 seconds, carrying the sequence number of the last tick message on the channel.

Field.Name: ApplLastSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the last market data message

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: Time the channel heartbeat was generated

Message.Name: Retransmission Message
Message.Description: Sent by the Vendor Supplied System to request tick data or announcements again; the gateway returns the data and then the same message type to mark the retransmission complete or report why it failed, so both sides transmit this message type.

Field.Name: ApplBegSeqNum
Field.Description: Starting sequence number, effective when ResendType = 1

Field.Name: ApplEndSeqNum
Field.Description: Ending sequence number, effective when ResendType = 1; when 0 the gateway sets it to the highest sequence number of the channel it holds in memory

Field.Name: NewsID
Field.Description: Announcement identifier, effective when ResendType = 2; an empty string requests the announcement summary

Field.Name: ResendStatus
Field.Description: Retransmission status, effective only on the gateway reply

Field.Name: RejectText
Field.Description: Effective only on the gateway reply; when the request is rejected, the error code is returned here

Message.Name: Snapshot Channel Statistics Message
Message.Description: Sent by each snapshot channel every 15 seconds.

Field.Name: MDStreamIDs
Field.Description: One entry per market data category carried on the channel

Message.Name: Business Reject Message
Message.Description: Rejects an application message that satisfies the session layer rules but not the business layer rules, mainly an invalid retransmission request.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the rejected message

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: Message type of the rejected message

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Business layer ID of the rejected message

Field.Name: BusinessRejectText
Field.Description: Reject reason text, up to 50 bytes that may include Chinese characters

Message.Name: Security Real Time Status Message
Message.Description: Real time status of a security, published every 10 minutes; the switch types are not yet enabled.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Security code, six digits behind two leading spaces

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Security code source, behind one leading space

Field.Name: Switch
Field.Description: One entry per security switch, giving its type and status

Message.Name: Announcement Message
Message.Description: Carries an announcement file; an empty NewsID marks the announcement summary, a text list of NewsNo, NewsID, Headline, RawDataLength, OrigTime and NewsType for every announcement issued. Under the multicast distribution protocol with announcement landing enabled, each announcement is sent as a summary that carries no content and has RawDataLength fixed to 0, its content being stored as a file.

Field.Name: NewsID
Field.Description: Unique identifier; an empty string marks the announcement summary, which is sent repeatedly

Field.Name: Headline
Field.Description: Announcement title, up to 128 bytes that may include Chinese characters

Field.Name: RawDataFormat
Field.Description: Binary data format, such as TXT, PDF or DOC

Field.Name: RawData
Field.Description: Binary data, its length given by the leading RawDataLength

Message.Name: Bond Spot Trading Snapshot Message
Message.Description: Snapshot of spot bond trading, market data category 010, published every 3 seconds.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Security code, six digits behind two leading spaces

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Security code source, behind one leading space

Field.Name: TradingPhaseCode
Field.Description: Trading phase code of the product. Only the first two characters are used: character 0 is the phase, S = start before the open, O = opening call auction, T = continuous trading, E = closed, H = temporary halt, V = volatility interruption; character 1 is 0 = cannot trade normally (before the open, suspended all day or after the close) or 1 = can trade normally

Field.Name: MDEntries
Field.Description: Market data entries disclosing the order book, with the orders at each price level nested inside

Field.Name: NoSubTradingPhaseCodes
Field.Description: Number of trading phase subdivisions, reserved

Field.Name: SubTradingPhaseCodes
Field.Description: One entry per trading phase subdivision, giving its code and trading type

Field.Name: TradeTime
Field.Description: Time of the most recent trade

Field.Description: Security code source, behind one leading space

Field.Name: TradingPhaseCode
Field.Description: Trading phase code of the product. Only the first two characters are used: character 0 is the phase, S = start before the open, O = opening call auction, T = continuous trading, E = closed, H = temporary halt, V = volatility interruption; character 1 is 0 = cannot trade normally (before the open, suspended all day or after the close) or 1 = can trade normally

Field.Name: MDEntries
Field.Description: Market data entries disclosing the order book, with the orders at each price level nested inside

Message.Name: Index Snapshot Message

Field.Description: Trading phase code of the index. Character 0 is the phase, S = start before the open, O = opening call auction, T = continuous trading or E = closed; the document does not define character 1 for indices

Field.Name: Index MDEntries
Field.Description: Market data entries giving the index points

Group.Name: MDStreamIDs
Group.Description: One entry per market data category carried on the channel

Field.Name: TradingPhaseCode
Field.Description: Closing status. Character 0 is T = continuous trading, not every security has closed yet, or E = closed

Group.Name: Switch
Group.Description: One entry per security switch, giving its type and status

Group.Name: MDEntries
Group.Description: Market data entries disclosing the order book, with the orders at each price level nested inside

Field.Name: MDEntrySize
Field.Description: Quantity. In a spot bond trading snapshot the last price entry (MDEntryType 2) uses it for the trading method that produced the price: 0.001 = matching, 0.002 = click, 0.003 = negotiated, 0.004 = inquiry, 0.005 = bidding

Field.Name: NumberOfOrders
Field.Description: Total number of orders at the price level; 0 means not disclosed

Field.Name: NoOrders
Field.Description: Number of orders disclosed at the price level; 0 means not disclosed

Field.Name: Orders
Field.Description: The individual order quantities disclosed at this price level

Group.Name: Orders
Group.Description: The individual order quantities disclosed at this price level

Field.Description: Trading phase code of the trading type
